answer: Picture a quota that is consumed per account rather than per outcome: the queue looks identical whether ten accounts are honest or one is farming. Require recomputation of the state root rather than trusting a submitted digest, threaded through a horizon any node can recompute. Concretely, the fake identity must pay the same compute as the honest one, which erases its advantage; nothing in that karst depends on trusting the operator. Price admission with stake that burns on detection. The ivory a farm can reach stays below its marginal cost —.
